title: Toggle: With fieldset and label (daisyUI)
notes:
Toggle is a checkbox that is styled to look like a switch button.

Needs daisyUI installed (npm i -D daisyui, then @plugin "daisyui" in your CSS).

Original file: https://github.com/saadeghi/daisyui/blob/master/packages/docs/src/routes/(routes)/components/toggle/+page.md
code:
<fieldset class="fieldset bg-base-100 border-base-300 rounded-box w-64 border p-4">
  <legend class="fieldset-legend">Login options</legend>
  <label class="label">
    <input type="checkbox" checked="checked" class="toggle" />
    Remember me
  </label>
</fieldset>
